reserve_profile.summary: STASIS reports EURS as fully backed by euro liquid balances held through central-bank and segregated-account arrangements, with daily statements, quarterly verification, and annual audit reporting.

redemption_profile.eligible_parties: Registered and verified STASIS customers subject to current terms and compliance review.
redemption_profile.fee_text: Current STASIS fees and banking charges apply.

reserve_profile.summary: EURT was issued under Tether's reserve framework. Current public materials verify token identity but do not provide a current asset-specific reserve breakdown sufficient to describe EURT independently from other Tether tokens.

redemption_profile.settlement_asset: Historically EUR through Tether customer processes
redemption_profile.eligible_parties: Historically verified Tether customers; current EURT-specific availability is unresolved.
jurisdiction_restrictions: Tether account and jurisdiction rules apply.

reserve_profile.summary: Mento V3 describes reserve-backed USDm as backed by collateral held in the Mento Reserve, including external fiat-backed stable assets used by protocol liquidity strategies.

redemption_profile.settlement_asset: Protocol-supported stable assets through pools, reserve mechanisms, bridges, or market routes
redemption_profile.eligible_parties: Users with chain and protocol access; no conventional issuer-account redemption right is represented.
redemption_profile.fee_text: Pool, protocol, bridge, and network fees may apply.

reserve_profile.summary: alUSD is issued as synthetic debt against supported yield-bearing collateral deposited in Alchemist positions. Collateral yield, repayments, and self-liquidations reduce debt and fund system conversion flows.

redemption_profile.settlement_asset: Underlying stable assets through the Transmuter or supported market routes
redemption_profile.eligible_parties: Users able to interact with supported Alchemix contracts and interfaces.
redemption_profile.fee_text: Network, liquidity, and route costs may apply.
redemption_profile.settlement_time_text: Transmuter conversion can be gradual and flow dependent.
